states.VALID: all inputs available at T, PIT-safe, within the declared freshness, full declared window
states.ASSUMED_INPUT: value present; it depends on an ASSUMED input (hypothetical capital, sqrt-time scaling, BTC reference choice)
states.DEGRADED_INPUT: value present; an input was marked DEGRADED by its source policy for a non-staleness reason (P2-X X1-DQ: collector not healthy, clock suspect, confirmation degraded) or a candle carries clock_suspect
states.GAP_AFFECTED: value present; the declared window has internal missing observations (no bridging) but n >= min_obs
states.STALE_INPUT: value present; the latest expected input was not yet available at T, or an input is DEGRADED for staleness by the P2-X stale policy
states.INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY: value null; fewer observations than the declared minimum (including history before the collector start or masked by W3)
states.UNAVAILABLE: value null; not computable (missing or INVALID input, zero variance, flat portfolio, refused by design, condition not met)

rules: value null <=> class UNAVAILABLE <=> state in {UNAVAILABLE, INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY}; a null always carries a reason
no zero-fill: an unknown beta, correlation, volatility, liquidity or drawdown is null, never 0
a known zero (flat exposure, no short positions, zero current drawdown on a supplied curve) is a value with its class
the primary state of a composite is the worst state of its parts; flags list every state that applies
every snapshot lists every null metric with its path, state and reason (unavailable)
